description: Flat metadata schema for individual record-level results from hybridoma-derived monoclonal antibody screening against cancer cell antigens, including purification, ELISA/flow cytometry binding characterization, and functional cell-based assays.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or assay result row.

antibody_name.descr: Internal name or clone designation of the monoclonal antibody (e.g., clone ID).

hybridoma_id.descr: Identifier of the hybridoma cell line used to produce the antibody.

host_species.descr: Species used to generate the antibody (e.g., mouse, rat).

target_antigen_name.descr: Name of the cancer cell antigen targeted by the antibody.

target_antigen_id.descr: Database or internal identifier for the target antigen, if available (e.g., UniProt accession, gene symbol).

target_cell_line.descr: Cancer cell line used for binding or functional testing (e.g., A549, MCF-7).

target_cell_type.descr: Cell type or cancer subtype of the target cells, if known (e.g., breast carcinoma, leukemia).

control_cell_line.descr: Negative-control or specificity-control cell line used in the assay, if applicable.

antibody_purification_method.descr: Method used to purify the antibody from hybridoma supernatant or culture medium (e.g., Protein A/G, affinity chromatography).

antibody_purity_percent.descr: Purity of the antibody preparation, expressed as percent (%) if measured.

antibody_concentration.descr: Final antibody concentration used in the assay or characterization step, with units specified in the associated protocol (e.g., µg/mL).

assay_type.descr: Primary assay associated with the record (e.g., ELISA, flow cytometry, apoptosis assay, proliferation assay).

assay_date.descr: Date when the assay was performed.

assay_condition.descr: Key assay conditions or format notes not captured elsewhere, such as temperature, incubation time, or fixation state.

elisa_signal.descr: Measured ELISA signal for antigen binding, such as absorbance or relative signal units.

elisa_background_signal.descr: Background or negative-control ELISA signal for reference subtraction, if available.

binding_affinity_kd.descr: Equilibrium dissociation constant (Kd) for antibody-antigen binding, typically in nM or M depending on the assay report.

binding_affinity_units.descr: Unit used for the reported binding affinity value (e.g., M, nM, pM).

flow_cytometry_mfi.descr: Mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) or comparable flow cytometry binding readout.

flow_cytometry_positive_percent.descr: Percentage of antigen-positive cells bound by the antibody, as measured by flow cytometry.

specificity_score.descr: Quantitative specificity measure comparing target versus off-target binding, if calculated.

specificity_metric_name.descr: Name of the specificity metric used (e.g., signal-to-noise ratio, target/off-target ratio).

apoptosis_percent.descr: Percentage of cells undergoing apoptosis after antibody treatment in a cell-based assay.

proliferation_inhibition_percent.descr: Percent inhibition of cancer cell proliferation caused by the antibody.

functional_effect_type.descr: Functional effect measured in the cellular assay (e.g., apoptosis induction, proliferation inhibition, both, none).

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of antibody treatment in hours for the functional assay.

dose_concentration.descr: Antibody dose used in the functional assay, with units specified in the associated protocol (e.g., µg/mL, nM).

dose_units.descr: Unit for the dose concentration value (e.g., µg/mL, nM).

replicate_count.descr: Number of experimental replicates used for the reported measurement.

mean_value.descr: Mean value of the primary quantitative outcome for the record, if applicable.

standard_deviation.descr: Standard deviation associated with the measured outcome, if available.

positive_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a positive control antibody or reagent was included in the assay.

negative_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a negative control was included in the assay.

qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the record passed predefined quality-control criteria.

notes.descr: Free-text notes about unusual observations, deviations from protocol, or interpretation caveats.
